results.detail:
I re-derived every unit from the raw DTSX.
- Population: the SQL selects Gen_customercare (Tout) with Gen_currentstate = 1. It inner-joins gen_accountcourses on gen_customercare, Gen_ftCurrentYear on ac.gen_fundnumber = ft.gen_fundnumber, and Gen_fundtransactiontype with gen_transgrouptype = 2. It also requires ft.Gen_EntryDate > Tout.CreatedOn. There is no predicate on care type, so 'ללא סינון לפי סוג הטיפול' is exact. 'ניוד יוצא' and 'פתוחים' are labelled השערה.
- Full transfer: Gen_isfulltransfer == TRUE leads to transferCount > 0 and then to Union All. One transaction is enough.
- Not-full branch: actual == expected, with both not NULL. expected = sum(ISNULL(ac.gen_transactionamount,0)) over the joined rows of a group (care, isfull, delivery date, account course, value date, appendix date). That equals the course amount times the number of transactions in the group, as flow_he[3] says.
- The 'Sums Are Not Equal' and 'Has not thansactions' outputs are unconnected.
- Aggregate: GroupBy (type 0) on Gen_customercareId, Gen_deliverydate and gen_appendixghissuingdate, with Minimum (type 6) on gen_valuedate. So there is one row per combination, and several updates per care are possible.
- Write: gen_customercare is updated through SDK ExecuteMultiple (RequestType.Update). It sets gen_currentstate = OptionSetValue(3), named by the constant CURRENT_STATE_FINISHED, and gen_rejectreason = OptionSetValue(34). It also sets gen_fundreleasedate = min value date (ToLocalTime, only when not null), gen_appendixghissuingdate (ToLocalTime, only when not null) and gen_deliverydelay = DateDiff(Day, delivery, value) > 0 (only when both exist).
Note, not a defect: a NULL Gen_isfulltransfer would be an evaluation error on IsFull (FailComponent). This is runtime plumbing and out of scope.
